gold.user: As a Twilio account holder, I want to retrieve a list of all my toll-free phone numbers so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array containing details of all toll-free phone numbers associated with my account, including their SID, phone number, friendly name, and status.

gold.user: As a Twilio user, I want to create a new toll-free phone number for my business so that I can provide a dedicated line for customer inquiries.
gold.ideal: The API should accept parameters for the new toll-free number, such as the phone number and friendly name, and return a JSON object with the details of the created toll-free number, including its SID and status.
